channel.title: Verified News
channel.description: Daily news digest — stories confirmed by multiple independent outlets, each with a Community Note and, where available, a verified YouTube news clip. Wire reprints count as one. Sources exclude BBC, CNN, CBC, and Radio-Canada. Canada and global viral social claims checked at the end.

item.title: Parti Québécois wins minority government — first return since 2014
item.description: The Parti Québécois won a minority government overnight, taking 59 of 127 seats — its first return to power since 2014, but short of a majority. The CAQ was shut out. A sovereignty referendum would come only after 2029. Community Note: minority, not majority; ~28% popular vote. Video: Separatists win Quebec election with promise to hold vote on independence (FRANCE 24 English) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gDMpCNteV_Q

item.title: Smith says she has no knowledge of reported separatist–U.S. strategist meetings
item.description: Premier Danielle Smith’s office said Monday she has no knowledge of reported meetings between Alberta separatists and U.S. strategists, and that she opposes separation or Alberta becoming a U.S. state. Sylvestre and Rath denied offering oil, water, or royalties.

item.title: Oct. 19 Alberta referendum: special ballots, advance voting, and safeguards
item.description: Albertans vote Oct. 19 on 10 referendum questions, including separation process. Elections Alberta: 652,000+ special ballots approved; packages due by 5 p.m. Oct. 16; advance voting Oct. 13–17. Video: Alberta Senate and Referendum Vote - General Information (Elections Alberta) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nDbd2yGHG6o

item.title: Hundreds rally at Churchill Square over Edmonton infill
item.description: Hundreds gathered Sunday at Churchill Square in Edmonton over residential infill. Public hearings are scheduled for Oct. 13. Video: Hundreds protest infill in Edmonton (CTV News) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5GVs9qvVSs

item.title: Six Nations Haldimand Tract trial opens in Toronto
item.description: A civil trial over the Six Nations’ Haldimand Tract land claim opened Monday in Toronto. Compensation ranges cited are claims, not awards; Canada and Ontario dispute liability.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region kills two; nearly 900 drones claimed intercepted
item.description: A Ukrainian drone attack on Russia’s Moscow region killed two people. Russian authorities claimed nearly 900 drones were intercepted. Intercept and casualty figures not independently verified drone-by-drone.

item.title: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces push toward Bab el-Mandeb; Houthi denial; unverified by AP/Reuters
item.description: Yemeni government and Saudi-backed forces said they drove Houthis from areas around Bab el-Mandeb. Houthis denied the claims. AP and Reuters could not independently verify.

item.title: Kenya records first Ebola death — imported case from DRC
item.description: Kenya reported its first Ebola-related death after an imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Contact tracing is under way. Video: Kenya reports first-ever Ebola death (FRANCE 24 English) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rAMXLpR479Q

item.title: Emera and Canadian Utilities announce $72-billion combination
item.description: Emera, Canadian Utilities, and ATCO announced an agreement to combine into a Canadian utility and energy infrastructure company valued at about $72 billion, subject to approvals.

item.title: Canada’s trade surplus widens to $4.2 billion in August
item.description: Statistics Canada reported that Canada’s merchandise trade surplus widened to $4.2 billion in August 2026, partly from exporters front-loading U.S. shipments ahead of new tariffs.

item.title: [Unconfirmed] Reports of Moscow-region fuel depot fire
item.description: Some reports described a fuel depot fire in the Moscow region. This has not been officially confirmed by independent reporting meeting the digest’s triangulation standard.

item.title: [Viral · Canada · False] Claim: non-Albertans can freely get mail-in referendum ballots
item.description: Viral claim that mail-in voting is open to anyone without residency checks is false. Elections Alberta manually reviews applications and requires Alberta ID with returned packages.

item.title: [Viral · Canada · Misleading] Claim: PQ won a majority and will hold an immediate referendum
item.description: Framing the Quebec result as a majority with an immediate sovereignty vote is misleading. PQ won 59 seats (minority); campaign stance was referendum only after January 2029.

item.title: [Viral · U.S. · False] Claim: Trump thanked Musk for making Republican votes count as three
item.description: Doctored Truth Social screenshot circulating ahead of U.S. midterms is false. Snopes: Musk “3 votes” line was edited into a real Oct. 3 Trump post.

item.title: [Viral · U.S. · False] Claim: Brazil’s same-day count proves U.S. elections are corrupt
item.description: Trump’s comparison of Brazil’s fast first-round results to slower U.S. counts is false. PolitiFact Pants on Fire: different systems; speed is not proof of rigging.

item.title: [Viral · Middle East · False] Claim: Viral compilation shows U.S. strikes on Iran
item.description: Compilation captioned as U.S. strikes on 140 Iran targets is false. Full Fact: old Gaza/Lebanon footage, simulated renders, and AI-watermarked clips.

item.title: [Viral · Europe · False] Claim: 80,000 French students vanished; mass graves from space
item.description: X claim of 80,000 missing French students and space-visible mass graves is false. Lead Stories: posting account later called it satire; no corroborating news.

item.title: [Viral · Asia-Pacific · False] Claim: AI video shows Albanese collapsing in Fiji
item.description: Viral clip of Australian PM collapsing face-first is false. Lead Stories: real APT arrival footage shows no fall; AI detector ~98.8% likely generated.
